M-PICKLE.Purpose: The in-game pickle suite: feature scenarios plus step bindings and probe widgets deployed into the test mod, executed inside the game container by the pickle harness (M-OP-TEST).

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Source/FlexVerse.Test/Pickle: Features/ (.feature files, deployed by the csproj glob), Behaviors/ and the flat step/fixture files, Diagnostics/ as the free-form agent sandbox.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Step classes bound by the compiled FlexVerse.Test.Pickle.dll; grep-marker scenario evidence written to Player.log.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Verdict derivation from markers — owned by M-RUNS (S-VERIFICATION.REQ-001).

Requirements.REQ-001: Features always live in Features/ (the csproj deploys via the Features/**/*.feature glob); steps and fixtures stay flat unless a topic clearly coheres into a directory.
Requirements.REQ-002: Feature selection is by file name (DEFAULT_FILTER in Scripts/_lib.py, runs section), so file location never changes which features run.
Requirements.REQ-003: All Pickle code shares the namespace FlexVerse.Test.Pickle; steps bind by assembly, not namespace.
Requirements.REQ-004: Scenarios assert via grep-stable markers: scenario:BEGIN/END and passed in Nms: name (S-VERIFICATION.PRIN-002).
Requirements.REQ-005: Diagnostics/ is the agent's sandbox: diagnostic scenarios are created there freely, extend the flat list by default, and are pruned when they outlive their purpose.

M-PICKLE.Codemap: * `Features/*.feature` : name-selected (runs.DEFAULT_FILTER) => csproj glob deploy * `Behaviors/TweenBehaviorSteps` -> tween.feature * `FlexEventSteps` + `EventProbe` widgets -> flexevent.feature * `FocusSteps` + `FocusProbe` fixtures -> focus.feature * `Diagnostics/FlexVerseSmokeSteps` + `SmokeWidget` -> flexverse-smoke.feature * `FlexVerse.Test.Pickle` : single ns, dll-bound steps * scenario:BEGIN/END + `passed in Nms` => Player.log markers => M-RUNS verdict
